prompt: Some people believe that studying at college or university is important for successful career. Others think that it is better to quit school and find work to gain experiences for a successful professional life. Discuss both these views and give your opinion.
essay:
While some would argue that studying at college or university is highly relevant for having a successful career, others would say that this path is not strictly required to achieve one's goals. In my personal view, choosing to pursue a degree and further studies in a specific field is certainly a rewarding experience, particularly considering the current job market, which has become increasingly competitive. This essay will discuss both points of view in this regard.

On the one hand, higher education and academic environments allow one to network and foster meaningful connections with scholars and experts early on. For instance, colleges and universities offer an array of different projects and initiatives for their alumni, which are often coordinated by leading professionals in their fields, granting them relevant opportunities to start building their experience. These opportunities, alongside the skills and technical expertise acquired during studies, are very important to early-career professionals when joining today's competitive and dynamic job market.

On the other hand, choosing not to chase a higher degree may also bring some benefits to one's professional journey. Although college and university are helpful in supporting the improvement of key skills, these environments could limit one's ability to develop skills related to more corporate-oriented spaces, which are often acquired through work experience in the field. For example, landing a role in a big company early in one's career may give them practical expertise and a set of contacts that would have been challenging to get from a purely academic environment, thus positioning them more strategically in the job market

In conclusion, choosing whether to seek higher education nowadays is definitely an important decision to make, especially for young people. In my opinion, universities and colleges offer relevant opportunities for early-career professionals, in which they can develop key skills in their field. At the same time, choosing not to join or quit the academic environment might also have its benefits depending on one's professional goals and desired paths.
